road_data: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), via Overture Maps Foundation

bbox._doc: Minneapolis plus about a mile of margin, so routes can leave the city limits where that is faster

default_speed_mph._doc: Used where OpenStreetMap has no posted limit (about 60% of drivable segments). Minneapolis's default limit is 20 mph on residential streets and 25 mph on most other city streets (2020 ordinance).

traffic_factor._doc: ESTIMATE: average travel speed as a share of the posted limit on a school day, allowing for signals, stop signs and school-hour traffic. No live traffic data was used.

settings._access_leg_doc: Speed on the short leg between a school's address point and the nearest street node (median 0.03 mi).
